title: Decent, Modern Set of Stainless Steel, Titanium Flatware Set
text:
Decent, Modern Set of Stainless Steel, Titanium Flatware Set. This 20 piece set - 4 sets of five piece settings of satin flatware. They are all reasonable well balanced, dishwasher safe, have a modern appearance and are reasonably priced.

In comparison to similar sets these are lighter in weight and I’ve found not as stable and durable as I expect. For example these spooned tend to bend when scooping ice cream.

At the price point of $1.40 per piece this is a reasonable low priced set that holds up well and will perform fairly well in normal daily use.

Depending of what yogi look for in flatware this could be an ideal set.
